parse_text_proto_to_message: parse a text format protocol buffer string into a protobuf message object using text_format.Parse
message_to_string: convert a protobuf message object to a human-readable text format string using text_format.MessageToString
merge_text_proto_into_message: merge a text format proto string into an existing message allowing last-value-wins for non-repeated fields using text_format.Merge
print_message_to_output: print a protobuf message to a file-like output object using text_format.PrintMessage with custom indent and formatting options
message_to_bytes: convert a protobuf message to encoded text format bytes using text_format.MessageToBytes with optional UTF-8 encoding
